descriptor: Latent Behavioral Regime Mixtures, Overdispersion Beyond Bernoulli Noise, Cross-Replicate State Persistence, Representation-Conditioned Switching Geometry & Model-Specific Stochastic Mechanism Adjudication

predecessor.key_result: Within-cell stochastic variation dominated complete Gemini decompositions, while no two-semantic alias-conditioned predictive law survived.

scientific_question: Is the large within-cell stochastic component observed in P45 compatible with conditionally IID Bernoulli variation once representation×alias×semantic cells are held fixed, or does prospective repetition reveal temporal persistence, split-block overdispersion, or synchronized wave-level switching that requires a structured stochastic description?

frozen_surface.response_contract: Exact P42-P45 provider-native strict contracts; no reselection.
frozen_surface.order: Every wave visits every fixed cell exactly once in an independently pre-seeded random order; wave order itself is fixed 1..8.

primary_estimands.lag1_persistence: Cell-centered lag-1 covariance pooled across fixed cells. Null is exchangeability of the eight wave outcomes within each cell.
primary_estimands.split_overdispersion: Mean squared difference between failure rates in waves 1-4 versus 5-8 across fixed cells. Null is within-cell wave exchangeability.
primary_estimands.wave_synchrony: Variance across waves of cell-centered residual failure means. Null is independent within-cell wave-label permutation, preserving each cell's total failure count.
primary_estimands.null_engine: 5000 synchronized within-cell permutations per model×semantic; one-sided greater-than tests.
primary_estimands.multiplicity: 12 primary tests = 2 models × 2 semantic twins × 3 stochastic-structure statistics; Holm FWER=0.05.

secondary_geometry.vertex_switching_map: For each model×semantic×vertex, report lag-1 centered covariance pooling four aliases; descriptive only.
secondary_geometry.alias_half_reproducibility: Compare vertex switching maps from aliases A+B versus C+D by cosine similarity; descriptive only.
secondary_geometry.failure_rate: Report model×semantic×vertex×alias empirical failure rates over eight waves.

gates.technical: Every model×semantic×vertex×alias cell requires >=7/8 exact-schema successful calls.
gates.evaluation_artifact: Primary-vs-shadow disagreement >=10% for a technically evaluable model triggers EVALUATION_ARTIFACT_DOMINANT.
gates.general_model_regime: A model earns structured stochasticity only if at least one primary stochastic statistic survives Holm correction in BOTH semantic twins.
gates.temporal_regime: A model earns TEMPORALLY_PERSISTENT_REGIME only if lag1_persistence survives Holm correction in BOTH semantic twins.
gates.semantic_specific: A significant corrected primary statistic in only one semantic twin licenses only semantic-specific non-IID structure.
gates.cross_family: Cross-family stochastic-mechanism language is allowed only if both model instances independently satisfy the same precommitted model-level gate.

frozen_rules: No P45 high-variance or significant cells are selectively enriched; all 32×4×2 cells are repeated.
Failure-count differences across cells are nuisance heterogeneity and are conditioned away by within-cell permutation.
A wave-level signal cannot be called an internal neural state; provider/runtime/time effects remain observationally aliased.
A lag signal licenses temporal dependence in observed behavior, not a hidden-state mechanism identification.
No threshold changes, cell deletion, or statistic substitution after outcomes.
No behavioral SVEC promotion follows from P46 alone.
harvest_linkage: XLIX: sampling uncertainty != specification uncertainty; repeated branches are not independent world contacts.
XLVIII: discrepancy/warnings belong to result semantics; simulator/model/world distinctions constrain mechanism language.
RITHM donor: stochastic finite-population dynamics and metastable switching are hypothesis generators only, not evidence for an LLM hidden state.
